narrative: Lyons & Rollins Partners (223:811A00890), a Saudi real‑estate partnership, received $806k from six counterparties and disbursed $18.2M to eight counterparties between 1‑11 Sep 2022. The largest outbound counterparty (148785:81239C380) received $13M via wire. A model‑generated 4‑hop cycle (subject → 119:811B6E2B0 → 222:811D80C30 → 121:8000E1590 → subject) was flagged, but ledger queries show seven cheque payments to 119 and a single ACH from 121 to the subject, while the two middle legs (119→222 and 222→121) have zero transactions. Consequently the ring is incomplete and does not constitute a laundering structure. High outbound volume and turnover exceed declared levels, but such patterns are typical for property‑development cash‑flows. No sanctions match exists for the subject; counterparty name‑only hits are likely false positives. Given the absence of a verified structural money‑laundering pattern, the alert is closed with a recommendation to monitor for any future completion of the ring.
decision_basis: Needs review: the model leaned CLOSE, but the measured structure (cycle 3/3, one_off_transfers 1/3, layered_transfers 1/3, pass_through 1/3, burst 1/3, turnover_vs_declared 1/3) meets the escalation standard, so the case is escalated for a human to weigh the model's reasons.
